Two fixes from the field. Just **force update** the container; your `/config` (JD install, settings, link list) is untouched.

## Added
- **ffmpeg is now bundled — YouTube/DASH downloads mux out of the box.** JDownloader does not download its own ffmpeg on Linux, so without a system binary it split a video into separate audio and picture files (`.opus` + `.jpg`) and popped a "FFmpeg is missing" install dialog — whose bottom (the confirm button) was clipped off by the kiosk window manager, so it couldn't even be dismissed. The image now ships `ffmpeg`/`ffprobe` and points JDownloader at them on first start, so muxing just works and that dialog never appears. (First proposed in community PR #2 — thanks to @ahmed-abdelrazek for flagging it.)

## Fixed
- **The package expand/collapse "+" handle is visible again in the Linkgrabber and the download list.** JDownloader ships no icon of its own for that toggle, so the image provides light-grey ones — but JD re-provisions its on-disk icon set during its self-update on startup, dropping exactly those two files, and the handle fell back to JD's dark default and vanished on the `#161616` background. The theme agent now restores the two icons inside the running JDownloader process (where the boot-time seed can't reach after a self-update), so the handle stays readable.
